read: Inflation pressure from the Gulf war remains the main theme: oil is expected to stay high longer, airlines cite jet fuel costs, and housing data is weakening under higher mortgage rates. Markets rebounded on tech earnings, but AI credit worries persist. Traders expect the Fed to hold next week.

fed.note: Markets expect a hold on Oct. 28 after September's hike, with housing weakness in focus.

week_ahead.why_it_matters: Sets borrowing costs; markets price a hold.
